name: secureModeCoveragePercentage
definition: Whole-number percentage (rounded down) of an application-control tool's current computers that enforce Application Control in Secure Mode with no active maintenance mode. It is the share behind ThreatLocker isEPPEnabled, so a requirement can set a coverage bar instead of failing a fleet over one machine.
population: computers the tool lists that are not deleted and checked in within 15 days of the newest check-in (endpoint rules 2026-09-29); a read is scored only when it holds every computer the organisation reports (totalRows).
evidenceRequiredForTrue: Not applicable: a percentage. A value is reported only from a complete computer list in which every judged computer carries a mode.
citations: safeguards/epp/threatlocker/isEPPEnabled.py (the boolean it replaces as a coverage bar)

changeLog.change: Registered with the ThreatLocker transform, its first implementation (spec S3: percentage thresholds in Spektrum-owned bundles).

notes: ThreatLocker isEPPConfigured measures the same thing under a contested key (percentage at some vendors, boolean at others); this name is uncontested and listed to ThreatLocker until another application-control vendor is reviewed.
